optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Product Requirements Analyst, Collaboration Software Subscriptions

professionalSummary.text: Turns requests from subscription operations and customer success into user stories, each with acceptance criteria.
professionalSummary.witness: Turned the weekly intake from subscription operations and customer success into user stories for the self-service seat-change and invoice-download pages, each story carrying its acceptance criteria.

experienceHighlights.text: Led acceptance sessions for the self-service billing pages and logs what passed and what failed.
experienceHighlights.witness: Led acceptance sessions for three billing-page releases with two operations analysts and a customer success manager, logging every criterion as passed or failed.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Published release notes covering limitations and what the support team needs to take over.

skills.text: Agrees release scope with engineering and subscription operations and keeps a record of who decided what.
skills.witness: Agreed release scope in sprint planning with the engineering manager and the subscription operations lead; scope and the release date were the engineering manager's call.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish that the candidate has fulfilled the requirements for user story creation, acceptance testing, release notes, and scope agreement. decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate has met most of the role requirements, but there is insufficient evidence to confirm the reduction in billing support tickets.
